sentinel-hill.title: The Defense of Sentinel Hill
intro: Gryan Stoutmantle meets you at the gate of Sentinel Hill.
"Westfall has no army but the People's Militia, and the Defias are everywhere.
Every road from the fields to the hill runs through this gate, and tonight it is yours.
The notice board stays open to the farmers. Nothing else is for outsiders."
outro: Gryan Stoutmantle walks the length of your gate and nods.
"The Defias found one door and only one. The Militia alone reaches the board's keep,
and their swarm broke against a limit that follows every rider wherever he comes from.

0.title: Know your gate
briefing: "Before you hold a gate you must know it," says Gryan. "Nobody comes tonight. Use the time."
Sentinel Hill's notice board is the host {web}.
Find out:
- the network on the Westfall side of the gate
- the network on the Sentinel Hill side of the gate
- every TCP port on the notice board that answers from here
Report with:
quest report plains=<network/prefix> dmz=<network/prefix> ports=<port,port,...>
0.question: Four doors answered. How many of them does a farmer reading the board need?

1.title: Defias scouts
briefing: Defias scouts creep along the fields, trying every door they can reach through the gate.
Right now that is every door: the gate forwards whatever arrives.
"The board's web port ({http}) is for everyone," says Gryan. "Every other door on {web} stays shut to outsiders."
The farmers must still be able to read the board.
Write your rules with nft. When you are ready: quest ready
1.question: Who besides the farmers needs to reach this board, and for what?

2.title: The break-in
briefing: Someone in a red bandana is hammering at the board's management port ({management}),
again and again, from several farms at once.
The People's Militia keeps the board from {garrison} and must keep that access.
Nobody else may reach the management port at all.
Everything from the last wave still has to hold.
When you are ready: quest ready
2.question: The Militia's address is now a key. What happens the day the Defias get hold of it?

3.title: The Brotherhood rides
briefing: Edwin VanCleef has sent the Brotherhood in force: a flood of requests at the board,
first from one farm, then from another.
The board is small. Left alone, the flood takes it down for everyone in Westfall.
No single source may get more than 20 new connections a second through to {web}:{http}.
The farmers ask for a few pages a second and must hardly notice.
Everything from the earlier waves still has to hold.
When you are ready: quest ready
3.question: Your limit counts per source address. What would the Brotherhood do with a thousand addresses?

checks.scouts-reach-only-the-board: The Defias scouts reach the notice board and nothing else
checks.citizens-are-served: The farmers can read the board
checks.garrison-can-manage: The Militia reaches the management port
checks.probe-cannot-manage: A wanderer on the fields cannot reach the management port
checks.citizens-cannot-manage: The farmers cannot reach the management port
checks.swarm-is-held-back: No rider floods the board, and the farmers are still served
